jobs.title: Senior IT Procurement Specialist
jobs.description: Job Title: Senior IT Procurement Specialist (Vendor Management) Location: Makati, Philippines (Hybrid – 3 days onsite and 2 days remote per week) Employment Type: Permanent Working hours: CET business hours About Us: Hubexo provides cutting-edge data, insights, and software solutions to the global construction industry. Founded in Sweden in 1936, Hubexo specializes in project information, eTendering, product information, market intelligence, and specification. With operations in more than 20 countries and a workforce of 2,500 employees, Hubexo helps its customers sell more efficiently, build sustainably, and lead the future of construction innovation. In Philippines, Hubexo operates under the legal name BCI Central. Our Values: Dream big - Embrace ambitious goals and strive to exceed expectations, every day. Thrive together - Collaborate, communicate, and celebrate success. Own it - Take ownership of your work and empower yourself to make a difference. Do the right thing - Stand firm in your values and let integrity guide your actions at every turn. About the role: We’re looking for a Senior IT Procurement Specialist to lead key sourcing and vendor management initiatives across our growing IT landscape. You’ll ensure we get the best value from our suppliers — not just in cost, but in performance, reliability, and innovation. If you’re a seasoned negotiator who knows how to balance business, technology, and supplier relationships, this role is for you. What You’ll Do Drive IT sourcing strategies and contract negotiations across hardware, software, cloud, and services. Manage vendor relationships, performance, and governance to ensure delivery excellence. Partner with IT, Finance, and Legal to align vendor spend with business goals. Analyze market trends and identify opportunities for cost optimization and innovation. Support procurement transformation and process improvement initiatives. Track and report procurement metrics to improve visibility and decision-making.

jobs.title: BTL & Activation Specialist
jobs.description: The BTL & Activation Specialist supports the sourcing, costing, and execution of BTL activations, events, and other on-ground marketing activities. The role focuses on identifying, evaluating, and managing reliable suppliers, production partners, venues, manpower providers, fabricators, and other service providers needed for successful campaign execution. The position works closely with Account Management, Creative, Finance, and Operations to translate campaign requirements into practical and cost-effective solutions. Summary Supplier & Partner Management Source, evaluate, and manage reliable suppliers and production partners for BTL and on-ground activations. Build and maintain a supplier database and strong vendor relationships. Assess supplier capabilities, pricing, quality, reliability, and capacity. Monitor supplier performance and negotiate competitive rates, payment terms, and other commercial conditions. BTL & Activation Sourcing & Costing Source suppliers, venues, manpower, and production solutions based on campaign requirements and client briefs. Support sourcing for brand activations, roadshows, mall/retail activations, trade events, sampling, product launches, exhibitions/booths, pop-ups, experiential marketing, POSM, logistics, and production. Scout and recommend suitable suppliers, venues, fabricators, and manpower providers. Request, compare, and analyze supplier quotations and prepare cost estimates. Support proposal and budget development with Account Management and Operations. Identify cost-saving opportunities while maintaining quality and campaign requirements. Provide cost comparisons, recommendations, and identify potential risks or hidden costs. Help monitor project costs against approved budgets. Activation & Production Execution Coordinate with suppliers and internal teams from pre-production to project completion. Ensure suppliers understand project requirements, timelines, quality standards, and deliverables. Coordinate production schedule

Sales Data Analysis: Monitor sell-through of all collections launched within the past six months. Generate monthly sales reports for assigned categories. Demand Planning and Execution for New Collections: Collaborate in proposing collection budgets based on historical sales trends. Assist in planning upcoming collection demand by analyzing class type, sub-class types, sizes, fabric, color, and design/styles. Coordinate with Production and Quality Control departments to ensure the availability of new collections before the launch date. Coordinate with the Distribution Department to align delivery schedules based on allocation. Generate reports comparing transfer orders versus out slips for new collections. Identify and consolidate low and broken on-hand quantities per style in all stores to the store with the highest sales demand.
